meta.title: Fish farming, sourcing and export from Egypt
meta.description: We farm and source fresh fish in Egypt, then grade, pack and export it for importers, distributors and foodservice buyers in the Middle East and beyond.

hero.title: Egyptian fish we farm and source for importers
hero.intro: We farm and source fish, then inspect, wash, ice, grade, pack and export it, with our own refrigerated trucks, logistics and cold stores.

chain.title: Farmed and sourced fish, one path
chain.intro: Fish we farm and fish we buy from other producers follow the same path, and the specification agreed with you guides every stage.
chain.farm_text: We farm fish and buy from other producers, matched to the species, quantities and timing you need.
chain.harvest_text: Fish are harvested and brought to our plant in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh.
chain.pack_text: Fish are washed, iced, graded by weight per piece and packed on ice.
chain.inspect_text: Checked against the agreed specification before the boxes are closed.
chain.export_text: Our own refrigerated trucks, then air or road freight.

species.title: 12 main species
species.intro: Open a species for its specification card, or search the full list.
species.more_species: These are our main, most-requested species; we supply other species on request.

farm.title: Supply that starts at the source
farm.text_1: We farm fish and buy from other producers, so we can match each buyer's species, quantities and timing. Tell us your volume and delivery window, and we plan supply with you.

processing.title: Prepared to the agreed specification
processing.text: We inspect, wash, ice, grade and pack every order to the specification agreed with you.
processing.point_1: Graded by weight per piece, to the range in your order
processing.point_2: Packing, net weight and labels as confirmed in writing
processing.point_3: Checked against the agreed specification before the boxes are closed

requirements.title: Start with the specification
requirements.intro: Tell us the species, weight grade, product form, packing, volume and destination. The export team reviews what we can supply and contacts you.
requirements.format_text: Our fish are sold whole and fresh chilled. Ask the export team about any other form you need.
requirements.grade_text: The weight range per piece your market needs.
requirements.packing_text: Box type, labels and label language.
requirements.destination_text: Country, city, delivery terms and required documents.

quality.title: Certified, and checked on every order
quality.text: We hold ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA. Every order is checked against the agreed specification before the boxes are closed.
quality.docs_email: Email the export team about documents
